question: Mr. RST starts from Point A and drives 16 km towards the south. He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 23 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 8 km, turns left and drives 3 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point A. In what direction (assuming any) and which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified)
solution:
Given:

Mr. RST starts from Point A and drives 16 km towards the south.

He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 23 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 8 km, turns left and drives 3 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eaf4fbdc6946b23ba5add5c1d8507fdfb6f4fc9461363ac6203b7ead756f7dec.png] 

Thus, Mr. RST should drive 6 km (4 km + 8 km - 6 km) in the east direction in order to reach Point A again.​

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
